legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: Every appeal under this Chapter shall be in such form and verified in such manner, as may be prescribed.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(1): Every appeal under this Chapter shall be in such form and verified in such manner, as may be prescribed.

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: An appeal referred to in sub-section (1), made to the Commissioner (Appeals) or to the Joint Commissioner (Appeals), shall be accompanied by a fee of —
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(2): An appeal referred to in sub-section (1), made to the Commissioner (Appeals) or to the Joint Commissioner (Appeals), shall be accompanied by a fee of —

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: Rs. 250, where the total income of the assessee as computed by the Assessing Officer in the case to which the appeal relates is Rs. 100000 or less;

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: The appeal shall be presented within thirty days,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(3): The appeal shall be presented within thirty days,—

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: from the date of service of the notice of demand where the appeal relates to any assessment or penalty; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(3): The appeal shall be presented within thirty days,— Section 358(3)(a): from the date of service of the notice of demand where the appeal relates to any assessment or penalty; or

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: in any other case, from the date on which intimation of the order sought to be appealed against is served.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(3): The appeal shall be presented within thirty days,— Section 358(3)(b): in any other case, from the date on which intimation of the order sought to be appealed against is served.

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of sub-section (3)(a), where an application made under section 440(1) is rejected, the period beginning from the date on which the application is made, to the date on which the order rejecting the application is served on the assessee, shall be excluded.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(4): For the purposes of sub-section (3)(a), where an application made under section 440(1) is rejected, the period beginning from the date on which the application is made, to the date on which the order rejecting the application is served on the assessee, shall be excluded.

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: The Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals) may admit an appeal after the expiration of the said period if he is satisfied that the appellant had sufficient cause for not presenting it within that period.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(5): The Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals) may admit an appeal after the expiration of the said period if he is satisfied that the appellant had sufficient cause for not presenting it within that period.

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: No appeal under this Chapter shall be admitted unless at the time of filing of the appeal,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(6): No appeal under this Chapter shall be admitted unless at the time of filing of the appeal,—

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: where a return has been filed by the assessee, the assessee has paid the tax due on the income returned by him; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(6): No appeal under this Chapter shall be admitted unless at the time of filing of the appeal,— Section 358(6)(a): where a return has been filed by the assessee, the assessee has paid the tax due on the income returned by him; or

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: where no return has been filed by the assessee, the assessee has paid an amount equal to the amount of advance tax which was payable by him.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 358 Form of appeal and limitation. Section 358(6): No appeal under this Chapter shall be admitted unless at the time of filing of the appeal,— Section 358(6)(b): where no return has been filed by the assessee, the assessee has paid an amount equal to the amount of advance tax which was payable by him.

legal_units.title: Form of appeal and limitation.
legal_units.text: The Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner (Appeals) may, for the purposes of sub-section (6)(b) and on an application made by the appellant in this behalf, for reasons to be recorded in writing, exempt him from the operation of the provisions of that sub-section.
